desc: DataForest/EPLB/PB-OEPLB baseline comparison, 8xH20, Qwen3-235B-FP8, TP=DP=EP=8, DeepEP+DeepGEMM, disable-cuda-graph, mem 0.78, O=1 pure prefill, 256 reqs, 3 runs median
base_config: 8xH20 96GB, Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8, TP=DP=EP=8 (16 experts/card), SGLang + DeepEP auto + DeepGEMM FP8, --disable-cuda-graph, --mem-fraction-static 0.78, --disable-radix-cache, max_new_tokens=1 (pure prefill), 256 concurrent reqs
key_finding: Cross-domain 4-domain balanced: ONLY PB-OEPLB positive (+10.4%); all static/redundant methods negative (DataForest -43%, EPLB-static -33%, EPLB-dynamic -1%). Same-domain prover: PB-OEPLB +21% ≈ DataForest +18% (frozen oracle), both > EPLB-static +9.6%.
caveats: DataForest/EPLB use prover placement (frozen, wrong for non-prover domains cross-domain). EPLB dynamic didn't rebalance in short burst (utilization threshold). PB-OEPLB needs full warmup (4 runs, 128 swaps) to adapt to 4 domains; steady-state reported.

cross_domain_4blk.note: STABLE low variance; DataForest fails(+0%), PB-OEPLB adapts(+5.9%)

universal4_NOTE: 4-domain 507tok short burst — HIGH VARIANCE/bimodal for ALL methods (PB-OEPLB oscillates -43%, NOT +10.4%; earlier +10.4% was a lucky draw). NOT a stable benchmark. Replaced by 4blk in paper.

freq6_cross_domain.note: STABLE: DF 4.7/4.7 (identical), PB-OEPLB steady 5.1 (run2 after convergence). Only PB-OEPLB positive cross-domain. ~= paper §5.2 +9.76% (N=600 vs 4200).

confirmed_two_datasets.cross_domain: freq6 (6seg book<->prover, O=10, conc=32, 4438tok) — STABLE effective dataset: DF+0% fails, PB-OEPLB+8.5%
